context: Use the existing no-checkout plus detached exact-ref implementation and its non-default-branch regression test. Keep this PR independent from the todo-db package and BenchBox runtime cutover.
description: Land and release the skill-sync Git source fix needed by consumers such as BenchBox that pin a non-default Git revision of skill-sync-skills. The adapter must resolve an exact pinned commit from a clean installation, including a commit not reachable from the default branch. This is a separate source-acquisition prerequisite, not a helper/CLI synchronization change.

anti_patterns.dont: Mix the Git adapter release with BenchBox runtime or database migration edits
anti_patterns.instead: Keep this as a separate package/release item
anti_patterns.why: Source acquisition and tracker cutover have independent rollback and release gates

anti_patterns.dont: Use the local dirty dist build as the only proof of consumer reproducibility
anti_patterns.instead: Verify the fixed package from a clean installation against an exact non-default revision
anti_patterns.why: A clean CI or cloud runner will use the released package, not the local uncommitted source

preserves.behavior: Git sources remain read-only and resolve configured branch, tag, and exact commit refs
dirty consumer worktrees and generated skill snapshots remain untouched
this change does not install or copy todo-db runtime code into skill directories
